Since the `channels(AggregatorMode)` helper was extracted specifically to support mode-dependent channel selection, consider also running this test with `AggregatorMode.PARTIAL` (or at least one multi-channel mode) to verify that `addIntermediateRowInput` works correctly when the intermediate representation spans multiple blocks. This would guard against regressions in the multi-channel path of the filtered aggregator's `next()` delegation.

The unchecked cast `((FilteredGroupingAggregatorFunction) input)` assumes the `input` parameter is always a `FilteredGroupingAggregatorFunction`, but the interface method signature (`GroupingAggregatorFunction#addIntermediateRowInput`) accepts any `GroupingAggregatorFunction`. If a non-filtered aggregator is ever passed (e.g., through a future code path or a different caller), this will throw a `ClassCastException` at runtime. Consider either:
- Adding an `instanceof` check with a clear error message, or
- Documenting the precondition on the method (e.g., `@throws ClassCastException if input is not a FilteredGroupingAggregatorFunction`) so callers are aware of the narrower contract.
